source_closure.summary: Implement the immutable P5 filesystem checkpoint store and narrow desktop local-API adapter behind the previously frozen execution protocols, using only temporary/fake test transports.

previous_job_bridge.relationship: The earlier receipt remains exact evidence for payload compilation and protocol-only bridge behavior; this source adds the concrete durable and desktop adapters.

properties: Every transition is serialized as canonical UTF-8 JSON with its ledger, transition-record, predecessor, and checkpoint hashes.
The first checkpoint must continue the separately configured authorized initial-ledger SHA and must be dispatch_attempted before external I/O.
Every later transition must continue the exact durable ledger and preserve the authorization identity.
Publication uses an exclusive temporary file, file fsync, and a no-replace hard-link; a mutable latest pointer is never written.
Unexpected paths, symlinks, multi-link files, sequence gaps, duplicate sequences, noncanonical bytes, tampering, replay, path escape, and mismatched authorization fail closed.
Crash-left temporary files are ignored only when they are ordinary hidden .tmp files; they can never become part of the verified checkpoint chain.
The module performs no I/O when imported and accepts only an injected desktop WebView page.
CDP connection is restricted to explicit HTTP loopback and requires exactly one tauri.localhost WebView.
The only mutating route is POST /api/v1/jobs with a frozen P5 idempotency-key format and a content hash that recomputes.
The only read routes are the authenticated session and exact Job, Trial, artifact, and report endpoints needed for P5 evidence collection.
The cloud access token is read and consumed only inside the WebView evaluate callback and is never returned to Node.
Job creation revalidates the exact installed Engine Pack ID/source and rejects unsupported, stale, or update-required status before POST.
Non-2xx, missing session, non-JSON, malformed base64, invalid UTF-8, oversized response, missing data envelope, invalid identifiers, and sensitive response fields fail closed.
